input.command:
python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0030.png"))
# The sofa is grey: let us find where the sofa pixels are
# R, G, B around 100-130
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 90) & (img[:, :, 0] < 140) & \
       (img[:, :, 1] > 90) & (img[:, :, 1] < 140) & \
       (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 150)

ys, xs = np.where(mask)
if len(xs) > 0:
    print(f"Sofa in obs_0030: x min={xs.min()}, max={xs.max()}, y min={ys.min()}, max={ys.max()}")
    print(f"Center pixel: x={xs.mean():.1f}, y={ys.mean():.1f}")
    # Lowest point (ground contact)
    print(f"Bottom contact row: {ys.max()}")
'
input.description: Analyze sofa bounding box in obs_0030
